title: Nasi goreng with chicken, vegetables and fried egg
steps: Cook the rice the day before or at least 1 hour ahead and let it cool.
Chop the shallots and garlic, dice the chicken and cut the carrot and cabbage into fine strips.
Fry the shallots, garlic and sambal in 1 tsp oil, add the chicken for 4 minutes, then the vegetables for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, soy sauce and maple syrup and fry, tossing, for 4 minutes, then fold in the spring onions.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil and serve on the rice with cucumber slices.
